what: Gartner sells research and advice to technology buyers. Executives pay an annual subscription to read its analysis, ask its analysts questions, and benchmark what they should be spending.
customers: Chief information officers and their teams, technology vendors, and increasingly finance, HR and supply chain executives.
money: annual subscriptions to research and analyst access
moat: Being the reference everyone cites. When a buying committee needs cover for a decision, a Gartner Magic Quadrant is the document it uses, and vendors subscribe because buyers do.
risks: Contract value growth has slowed as technology vendors, a large customer group, cut spending
AI research tools could erode the value of paying for analyst summaries
opportunities: 12.3 times earnings and 8.4 times free cash flow with $1.3B of free cash flow
Revenue grew from $4.7B to $6.5B in four years and subscriptions renew at high rates
Analysts see about 17% upside, and the company buys back stock steadily
watch: Contract value growth, which leads research revenue, particularly among technology vendors.
